tools.name: list_states
tools.description: List every US state and the District of Columbia, with the statute that governs a refusal of anatomical gift there. Use this to find which jurisdictions are covered or to get the exact name to pass to get_state.

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: What one US jurisdiction requires to refuse anatomical gift. Use this for any question naming a state; use get_faq for a general one. Returns the statute citation, a plain-language summary, and a facts list: which act the state enacted, whether witnesses are needed when you sign it yourself and when

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_site" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Find which WearableDocs page answers a question, by keyword. Returns `matches`, best first, each with the page `url`, a `markdown` address for a clean copy of t…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_site, get_products · Private data: search_site, get_products, get_pricing · Public sink: get_products.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_site, get_products · Private data: search_site, get_products, get_pricing · Public sink: get_products

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
